title: Boeing: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
summary: John Oliver's Last Week Tonight segment on Boeing, tracing how it went from a quality engineering company to one tied to crashes and 'quality escapes'. It covers the 737 MAX failures and employee concerns about safety.
why: HN recommends it as an entertaining and thorough overview of Boeing's decline whenever the company's safety problems are in the news.

quote.text: There is a very nice episode of Last Week Tonight by John Oliver diving into it
